title: The Bosphorus Brief — 9 August 2026
overview: A new defense pact between Türkiye, Saudi Arabia, and Pakistan dominates today's coverage, alongside good news for foreign graduates on residency permits. Regional tensions over the Strait of Hormuz and a drone incident near Bulgaria's border add to a watchful but not alarming backdrop for the region.
sections: <parameter name="body">The lira sits at 47.71 to the dollar and 55.12 to the euro today. ING Think notes that easing geopolitical tension is helping support Türkiye's disinflation efforts, while JPMorgan has reportedly taken profit on Turkish lira swap positions as bets grow on future rate cuts — a modest signal of market confidence, though not a guarantee of near-term relief at the till.
heading: Lira and Rate Watch
closing: Stay grounded, keep your paperwork handy, and enjoy the Sunday quiet — more tomorrow.
